blocks.html: The wait is finally over as Robinsons Place Valencia holds its grand opening on December 12. The celebration for its opening will be filled with great surprises. Catch Kapamilya heartthrob, Xian Lim on December 12 with Miss Earth Philippines 2018, Silvia Celeste Cortesi. The fun continues with Kapamilya hunk Enzo Pineda on December 13. Meanwhile, kids and even the young-at-heart will enjoy the company of Pinkfong and Baby Shark on December 16 while Tayo, the little bus makes new friends on December 20. Finally, reminisce special moments with your loved ones while gazing at the beautiful fireworks display on December 30.

As the Christmas Season draws near, Robinsons Malls will be giving the people of Valencia the perfect place where they can experience a complete shopping experience as Robinsons Place Valencia finally opens its doors on Wednesday, December 12.
The 51st Robinsons Mall is set to redefine the lifestyle, retail, leisure and entertainment landscape of the province with its superb and sophisticated store retail mix, – from a fabulous array of stores that is sure to excite the public to its list of must-try restaurants ready to give a first-rate dining experience to all patrons.
To make the celebration of the mall’s grand opening more memorable, Kapamilya Heartthrob Xian Lim will entertain the audience as he captures their hearts with his charm. Also giving a special appearance is Miss Earth Philippines 2018, Silvia Celeste Cortesi, who finished in the top 8 of the Miss Earth 2018.
Sen. Juan Miguel Zubiri will lead the ribbon cutting ceremony at the grand opening together with Hon. Azucena Huervas, Mayor of Valencia City, Governor Jose Ma. Zubiri, Jr. and Hon. Rogelio Neil Roque Congressman of the 4th District. Joining them is the team from Robinsons Land. As the new Robinsons Place Valencia finally opens, more exciting offerings will surely come for everyone to enjoy! Kapamilya hunk, Enzo Pineda, visits the mall to bond with his fans on December 13. Kids and even the young-at-heart will surely enjoy the company of Pinkfong and Baby Shark on December 16. Plus, have your little ones meet Tayo, the little bus on December 20. Finally, before 2018 comes to a close, take a trip down memory lane as you reminisce special moments with your loved ones while gazing at the beautiful fireworks display on December 30.
See the complete line-up of Robinsons Malls’ promos and events when you visit www.robinsonsmalls.com or like RobinsonsMalls and RobinsonsPlaceValencia on Facebook; follow @RobinsonsMallsOfficial on Instagram; and @RobinsonsMalls on Twitter.
